answer: A cipher-sealed join fee burns bulk fakes. Each identity pays a 55 entry fee, burned at entry and key-bound on the public nebula board, so a copied or rented identity must pay the fee again. Each epoch a pulse audit replays every burn receipt; a reused receipt voids both identities at once. Buying 1,000 fakes costs 55,000 in fees for a 40,000 pool, so the farm loses 15,000 before earning anything. One honest agent pays 55 and keeps its share.
